'''Defaris Muslo''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] who despised the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], blaming them from the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his daughter, [[Marna]]. Cruel, cunning, and manipulative, Muslo was known to construct elaborate traps to capture Rebels. Muslo was unaware that his daughter was, in fact, a Rebel operative who was tortured to death by an Imperial [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] suspected that Muslo was a Rebel operative like his daughter, and target him for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]].
